exercise.name: Toe Touch Crunch
steps: Lie face up with your legs pointing straight at the ceiling.
Reach your hands toward your toes, lifting your shoulders off the floor.
Lower your shoulders slowly, keeping your legs still.
exercise.one_line_summary: Lying face up, legs held vertical (thighs at 90 deg to the floor, knees nearly straight), arms reaching up. The upper trunk curls ~35 deg so the shoulder blades leave the floor and the hands reach toward the shins/toes; legs and low back stay still. Rectus abdominis is the target.

setup.target: Legs raised so the thighs are vertical, knees straight or softly bent, toes pointed away.
setup.tolerance: thigh 85-95 deg to the floor; knee bend 0-20 deg
setup.why: ACE vertical toe touches: thighs vertical, not past vertical (past vertical shifts load onto the low back).

setup.target: Low back pressed into the floor through the whole rep.
setup.why: ACE cue; the curl is in the upper trunk.

setup.target: Arms long, reaching up toward the feet.

movement.measure: upper-trunk forward bend off the floor
movement.end: about 35 deg (shoulder blades completely off the floor)
movement.path: Roll up and down; do not jerk.
Still. Legs do not swing toward the head.

movement.measure: arm elevation in the torso frame (90 = straight out of the chest)
movement.path: Arms stay long and follow the trunk up.

movement.measure: neck in line with the upper back

muscles.emg: Crunch among the highest for upper/lower RA (S2, no % in abstract); V-sit (legs and trunk raised) ~80% MVIC RA (Maeo, in S3).
muscles.role: Curls the rib cage toward the pelvis.
muscles.surface: Vertical bands down the front of the belly.

muscles.role: Help the curl; not lit (not the target).

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Feet swing toward the face as the trunk curls.
mistakes.why_it_matters: ACE: shifts weight onto the low back.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Head pushed forward, shoulders barely leave the floor.

sources.citation: American Council on Exercise. Vertical Toe Touches (ACE Exercise Library).
sources.what_it_gave: Thighs vertical, toes pointed, curl until shoulder blades leave the floor, hands slide toward the ankles, low back pressed down, do not pass vertical.

sources.citation: Escamilla RF, McTaggart MS, Fricklas EJ, et al. 2006. An electromyographic analysis of commercial and common abdominal exercises. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 36(2):45-57. doi:10.2519/jospt.2006.36.2.45
sources.what_it_gave: Crunch among the highest for RA and obliques.

sources.citation: Oliva-Lozano JM, Muyor JM. 2020. Core muscle activity during physical fitness exercises: a systematic review. Int J Environ Res Public Health 17(12):4306. doi:10.3390/ijerph17124306
sources.what_it_gave: V-sit ~80% MVIC RA (close variant: trunk and legs raised).

clip_check.check: End: shoulder blades off, hands toward the shins
clip_check.target: curl 25-45 deg; hands within ~0.2 m of the shins
